# Houszy - Online E-Commerce Store

> Houszy is a leading UK online retailer specializing in high-quality Kitchenware, Fitness Equipment, Homeware, Household Essentials, and Toys.

## Main Product Categories
- [Kitchenware](https://www.houszy.co.uk/category/kitchenware): Cookware, food storage, glass containers, and dining items.
- [Homeware](https://www.houszy.co.uk/category/homeware): Bedding, storage solutions, and home accessories.
- [Fitness Equipment](https://www.houszy.co.uk/category/fitness): Dumbbells, resistance bands, and home workout gear.
- [Household Essentials](https://www.houszy.co.uk/category/household): Cleaning supplies, laundry products, and organization.
- [Health & Personal Care](https://www.houszy.co.uk/category/health-personal-care): Toiletries, wellness, and self-care products.

## Store Information & Services
- **Website**: https://www.houszy.co.uk
- **Delivery**: Free standard delivery available on all UK orders.
- **Support**: 100% secure transactions with fast dispatch and customer support.
